fragments.summary: This book is a practical guide to the theory and practice of adult education (andragogy) as opposed to the teaching of children (pedagogy). Following the first chapter 'Preparing yourself to inquire', the book is set out in three parts. 'Part I - The emerging role and technology of adult education' contains the chapters: What is modern practice?; What is the role and mission of the adult educator?; and What is andragogy?. 'Part II - Organizing and administering comprehensive programs of adult ed
